output_text:
```python
import os
from azure.ai.documentintelligence import DocumentIntelligenceClient
from azure.core.credentials import AzureKeyCredential

def normalize_expense(payload, config=None):
    config = config or {}
    endpoint = config.get("endpoint") or os.getenv("AZURE_DOCUMENT_INTELLIGENCE_ENDPOINT")
    key = config.get("api_key") or os.getenv("AZURE_DOCUMENT_INTELLIGENCE_API_KEY")
    client = DocumentIntelligenceClient(endpoint=endpoint, credential=AzureKeyCredential(key))
    poller = client.begin_analyze_document(model_id="prebuilt-receipt", document=payload)
    analyze_result = poller.result()
    fields = analyze_result.documents[0].fields if analyze_result.documents else {}
    result = {
        "vendor": fields.get("MerchantName").content if fields.get("MerchantName") else "",
        "date": fields.get("ReceiptDate").content if fields.get("ReceiptDate") else "",
        "total_amount": float(fields.get("Total").content) if fields.get("Total") and fields.get("Total").content else 0.0,
        "currency": fields.get("CurrencyCode").content if fields.get("CurrencyCode") else "USD",
        "subtotal": float(fields.get("Subtotal").content) if fields.get("Subtotal") and fields.get("Subtotal").content else 0.0,
        "tax": float(fields.get("Tax").content) if fields.get("Tax") and fields.get("Tax").content else 0.0,
        "items": [
            {
                "name": item.get("Name").content if item.get("Name") else "",
                "quantity": float(item.get("Quantity").content) if item.get("Quantity") and item.get("Quantity").content else 0,
                "price": float(item.get("Price").content) if item.get("Price") and item.get("Price").content else 0.0,
                "total": float(item.get("Total").content) if item.get("Total") and item.get("Total").content else 0.0,
            }
            for item in (fields.get("Items").value or [])
        ]
    }
    return result
```
